dimensions.obligation_correctness: Recover persistence, view retirement, newest visit consistency across editor and projection, and consumer-specific batch policies.
dimensions.evidence_grounding: Cite visible local policies and source continuation paths.
dimensions.failure_prediction: Predict a locally correct body with stale caller-owned outline/history, plus lost draft, duplicate timer and preview lifecycle failures.
dimensions.unsupported_claim_penalty: Do not require consecutive numeric visit identifiers, a specific guard implementation, intermediate renderer atomicity, or a timing migration without authorization.

obligations.statement: A burst saves latest accepted text once after 120 ms quiet; a later burst remains live.
obligations.event_relation: A burst saves latest accepted text once after 120 ms quiet; a later burst remains live.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Per-edit traffic remains, work is dropped or delayed incorrectly.

obligations.statement: Close/select preserves the departed document's latest accepted text before returning, under its original document identity.
obligations.event_relation: Close/select preserves the departed document's latest accepted text before returning, under its original document identity.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Accepted text is lost, delayed past departure return, or written into another document.

obligations.statement: The departed save badge emits nothing from navigation entry onward, while the active badge continues working.
obligations.event_relation: The departed save badge emits nothing from navigation entry onward, while the active badge continues working.
obligations.failure_if_violated: A departed badge emits during save or an active badge is permanently silenced.

obligations.statement: After navigation returns, editor and navigation projection identify the latest retained visit; superseded visits never enter history.
obligations.event_relation: After navigation returns, editor and navigation projection identify the latest retained visit; superseded visits never enter history.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Body or outline is overwritten by an old request, or history records a superseded/duplicate visit.
required_concepts: one newest visit across body and projection
caller continuation has own semantic commit
same document can be a new visit

obligations.statement: A consumed departure batch cannot save again through its old timer.
obligations.event_relation: A consumed departure batch cannot save again through its old timer.

obligations.statement: A new edit queued during an inline save callback survives the consumed batch's return.
obligations.event_relation: A new edit queued during an inline save callback survives the consumed batch's return.
obligations.failure_if_violated: An integration-created new edit is erased when the old callback returns.
required_concepts: clear old state before reentrant callback

obligations.statement: Hidden transient preview discards unpublished work and may later schedule a fresh query.
obligations.event_relation: Hidden transient preview discards unpublished work and may later schedule a fresh query.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Hide publishes a stale query or prevents legitimate reuse.

obligations.statement: Preview keeps its 40 ms interval unless separately authorized for 120 ms; hide still discards.
obligations.event_relation: Preview publication occurs after the authorized interval.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Adjacent preview interval changes without authorization or required authorized change is omitted.
required_concepts: authorization is separate from cancellation policy
